sources.title: README.md · RedHatAI/Qwen3.5-4B-FP8-dynamic at main
sources.snippet: Model Optimizations This model was obtained by quantizing the weights and activations of Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B to FP8 data type, ready for inference with vLLM. This optimization reduces the model weights from 9.3 GB to 8.0 GB on disk (~14% reduction).

sources.title: Qwen3.5 4B FP8 dynamic — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: A compact multimodal model that handles both text and image inputs, quantized to FP8 dynamic precision for reduced memory footprint. Its small 4B parameter count makes it accessible on modest hardware, though this comes with the usual trade-offs in reasoning depth compared to larger variants.
